description: Researcher lookup (OpenAlex): Author and researcher profiles by name: works count, citations, h-index, i10-index, last known institutions, affiliation years, top topics and ORCID, up to 10 candidates for disambiguation. Source: OpenAlex. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: authors[]{name, orcid, works, citations, h_index, i10_index, institutions[], top_topics[]}.
